corrections.why: The register's location line misspells the county as 'Calavares County'; the Forest Lookouts header and the FFA list both say Calaveras

notes_for_editor: Register spells the county 'Calavares' (corrected in the brief). Two unreconciled points: the register gives 4,990 ft (1,521 m) for the site and 4,855 ft for the Calaveras Ranger District, and a photo captioned 1920 predates the 1934 build date. The Forest Lookouts page is a header only (county and forest). No staffing, fire or access information in any source read, so facts.staffing and facts.access are omitted. Photo captions name the Stanislaus NF Archive but give no image URL, so none added to photos. The register says cooperative 'probably', which the story keeps. Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 4 page reads for this tower.
